name: Mark Lamb
summary: Mark Lamb (born July 14, 1972) is an American law enforcement officer and politician who is the United States representative-elect from Arizona's 5th congressional district. Lamb served as sheriff of Pinal County, Arizona, from January 1, 2017, until December 31, 2024. He is a member of the Republican Party.
